title: Which court, if any, will grant Christa Pike a stay on the day of her scheduled September 30, 2026 execution?
background: Christa Pike is on Tennessee's death row for the 1995 killing of Colleen Slemmer.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth: Use the court's order or contemporaneous reporting to identify the court.  
      Resolution Date: Resolve to the court that grants a stay of Pike's execution on September 30, 2026, before her scheduled execution time that day.  
      Accepted Answer Format: Answer with its commonly used short name.
